title: Tianji Record: Shackles Manifested
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji stood at the crossroads of destiny, before him the path to the core of the Heavenly Eye. His father, Chen Tianming, awaited him there—a reunion delayed for twenty years, about to unfold in the cruelest manner imaginable.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji's rage surged, the ink-like patterns on the first page of the Tianji Record began to writhe violently—the very same patterns as the memory fragments he had lost in childhood. The pitch-black lines twisted like living things, climbing from his fingertips up his wrists, bringing a bone-piercing chill.

Father... this is the first talisman Father taught me to draw! Chen Ji's heart pounded violently as dormant memories flooded forth like a breached dam. That rainy night, Chen Tianming had gripped his hand and laid the final stroke on paper, and then... and then he remembered nothing.

The ink patterns writhed with increasing intensity, as if responding to Chen Ji's surging emotions. The edges of the first page began to emit a strange golden light—wherever the golden light touched, a tiny crack appeared in the void—the location of the third page. Then, the crack expanded rapidly.

dialogue.content: (Inhaling sharply) The third page... no, this is—!

text.content: Golden light exploded, the fourth page burst forth! Chen Ji felt a thunderous roar in his mind, and his vision instantly transformed. He saw a man suspended by countless golden chains in the void—that man, gaunt-faced yet with piercing eyes, was his father Chen Tianming!

Father! Chen Ji reached out instinctively, but only touched phantom light. Text began to appear on the fourth page, each character seared into his consciousness like a branding iron: 'Heavenly Fate Chains, not binding life, but binding Heavenly Secrets. The record-holder's father, using his body as the chain, has been sealing the Heavenly Eye for over nineteen years.'

dialogue.content: Nineteen years... from the year he left the Tianqing Sect, he has been trapped there! Chen Ji's fists clenched tight, nails cutting deep into his palms, blood dripping to the ground. And my sister? Chen Nian! She is also a key—

text.content: The fourth page seemed to hear his questioning, and the text continued: 'Chen Nian, key of Heavenly Fate, for unlocking purposes. The Holy Sect has imprisoned her body for seventeen years, awaiting the right moment to offer her to the Heavenly Eye.届时，锁开眼睁，万物归虚。'

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, aged and weary) Master, this old servant knows you have many questions. But time is running out—the appearance of the fourth page will alert the Heavenly Eye. You must make your choice quickly.

choice.prompt: The fourth page of the Tianji Record has manifested. Chen Ji faces a choice:

choices.description: Accept the complete information灌输 from the Tianji Record, face the truth of his father's imprisonment, and integrate the fourth page's power into himself.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the 'Shackle Eye' skill, able to perceive the weaknesses of all restraints and seals
choices.risk_hint: Massive consumption of Heavenly Fate, and will expose location to the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, reaching out his right hand toward the fourth page. Scorching power instantly flooded into his eyes, and amid the excruciating pain he saw the pattern of every chain binding his father—those were imprints of the Heavenly Dao, powerful enough to inspire despair. But simultaneously, he also saw the chains' weaknesses.

dialogue.content: (Grinding his teeth) So that's how it is... Father, you've been trapped here for twenty years, waiting for me. Waiting for the day when I could open these chains.

choices.description: Suppress the grief and rage in his heart, use the Tianji Record to deduce the optimal plan for rescuing his father and sister, combat the Heavenly Eye with strategy.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete action route: requires Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist for concealment + Su Qingyao's barrier-breaking ability + entry into the Heavenly Eye core
choices.risk_hint: Deduction results may involve enormous sacrifices

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcing himself to remain calm. Father waited nineteen years—he could spare a moment more. He began deducing possible plans using the Tianji Record, light images flickering before his eyes.

dialogue.content: (In a low voice) Demonic Path mist conceals aura, Su Qingyao breaks barriers to open the way, I focus on breaking the locks... but it's not enough. To thoroughly defeat the Heavenly Eye, we need the complete Tianji Record. And the complete version lies within its core.

choices.description: Regardless of cost, immediately follow the sensing toward where his father is trapped, forcefully break the locks by force.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger the Heavenly Eye's alertness, encounter the strongest backlash
choices.visible_reward: Immediately see father Chen Tianming, obtain first-hand information
choices.risk_hint: Forcefully breaking the formation with current strength, success rate less than thirty percent

text.content: Chen Ji rose abruptly, fury blazing in his eyes. Nineteen years! He had waited nineteen years! What Heavenly Eye, what inevitable backlash—he only wanted to see his father now!

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng urgently interjected) Master, wait! With your current strength, going would be suicide! Even a single thought from the Heavenly Eye could crush you to bits!

text.content: Just as Chen Ji struggled, a blurry figure suddenly appeared on the fourth page. That figure overlapped with the girl in Chen Ji's memories—Chen Nian! The girl's lips quivered slightly, seeming to speak, but the blurry image made it impossible to hear clearly.

Niannian! Chen Ji reached out again, and this time his fingertips touched the blurry light image. A familiar aura flooded his heart—that bloodline connection, his sister he had searched for years. Tears fell silently.

dialogue.content: (Chen Nian's voice came through intermittently) Brother... don't come... it's a trap... they want... to use me... to lure you...

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's warning put Chen Ji in a dilemma:

choices.description: Chen Nian's warning must be true, temporarily hold position and re-examine the overall situation.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the golden opportunity to rescue father
choices.visible_reward: Avoid walking into the trap, gain time for a more thorough plan
choices.risk_hint: Enemy may seize the opportunity to relocate Chen Tianming

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully pulled back his focus. Niannian never lied to him since childhood—if she says trap, it must be a trap. He forced himself to calm down and began re-analyzing the information conveyed by the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: (Eyes turning cold) What a fine 'invite the guest into the pot' scheme. The Holy Sect and Heavenly Eye joining forces to set a trap, waiting for me to walk into the net myself... Unfortunately, you encountered me, Chen Ji.

choices.description: Knowing it's a trap but going anyway—the enemy's scheme precisely shows they fear Chen Ji.
choices.visible_cost: Face danger directly, possible serious injury
choices.visible_reward: Disrupt enemy deployment, gain battlefield initiative

text.content: A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. Trap? They think using Chen Nian can bait him? Hmph, little do they know that Chen Ji's specialty is delivering a fatal blow where the enemy feels most confident.

dialogue.content: (Coldly) Since it's a trap, let me see what exactly this trap conceals. Niannian, wait for me.

text.content: Just then, the light of the fourth page of the Tianji Record began to fade, but before completely vanishing, the final line of text seared into Chen Ji's mind: 'To save Chen Tianming, you must enter the core of the Heavenly Eye. The complete Tianji Record awaits you there. Chen Ji—I have waited for you a long time.'

dialogue.content: (The Heavenly Eye's voice rang like a great bell, making Chen Ji's eardrums ache) The chess piece finally sees the board? Interesting... Bring your incomplete Tianji Record to me. Your father longs to see you.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, cold sweat beading on his forehead. The Heavenly Eye's consciousness was so powerful that a single sentence shook his mind. But what alarmed him more was the implication in those words—it said 'the chess piece finally sees the board,' which meant all his schemes from the beginning had been under its observation?

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's open provocation, Chen Ji must state his stance:

choices.description: Respond to the Heavenly Eye with equal arrogance, letting it know he is no chess piece to be manipulated.
choices.visible_reward: Not lose ground in momentum, earn dignity

text.content: Chen Ji laughed uproariously to the sky, his voice carrying wildness and pride. Heavenly Eye? Very well, let me show you how the chess game you personally arranged will be overturned by the chess piece you most despise!

dialogue.content: (Shouting) You said I couldn't see the board? Now I see it, and I will tell you—this game, I Chen Ji accept!

choices.description: Don't respond to provocation, silently digest the information, prove everything with action.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain mystery, preventing the enemy from judging true intentions

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, merely closing the Tianji Record slowly. Cold smile? Angry retort? Neither was necessary. The more the opponent wants you agitated, the calmer you must be. He had already decided what to do next.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring softly) Very well, I've seen the board, I've played the piece. But the ending of this game will never follow your script.

text.content: The fourth page of the Tianji Record had completely faded, but Chen Ji felt a change occurring in his eyes. He could see every strand of spiritual energy fluctuation in the air, could see the formation rune patterns shrouding the distant Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate—the initial awakening of the Shackle Eye, perhaps?

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again: 'Master, the information from the fourth page is too vast—your body needs time to digest. But one thing must be told immediately—Chen Nian's imprisonment location, this old servant has pinpointed. It lies in the outer layer of the Heavenly Eye core, protected by nine layers of Heavenly Fate seals.'

dialogue.content: (Eyes sharp) Nine seals... meaning nine people with barrier-breaking abilities must act simultaneously. Mo Xiansheng, besides Su Qingyao's barrier-breaking talent, who else excels in this art?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng pondered before replying: 'Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist can break three of them, Su Qingyao can break two. Your Shackle Eye, Master, can perceive the weaknesses of all seals. If we add variables within the Holy Sect... this game is far more complex than this old servant anticipated.'

Chen Ji rose slowly, his gaze fixed on the distant horizon. Father trapped in the Heavenly Eye core, sister imprisoned in the outer layer, and the complete Tianji Record waiting for him there. This was no coincidence—it was fate's deadly game arranged for him. But Chen Ji never accepted fate—he believed in only one principle: man proposes, heaven disposes. And Chen Ji was the one who rewrites destiny.

dialogue.content: (Gripping the Tianji Record tightly, eyes firm) Father, Niannian, wait for me. This time, I will be the one arranging the world.
